answer: Each agent deposits a stake that is locked in a smart‑contract prism; the contract issues a reputation token whose weight grows quadratically with the cumulative stake rather than linearly with the number of identities. When a new identity tries to join the harbor, it must acquire the same stake, so a Sybil swarm of ten cheap nodes contributes only the square‑root of the influence of a single well‑funded node. The attacker therefore pays the full quadratic cost, turning a cheap reef of fake IDs into an economically prohibitive venture.
